items.question: What is the number of the Ministerial Resolution from 2020 on the inclusive education policy for people of determination in UAE government schools?
items.gold: Ministerial Resolution No. 647 for the year 2020.
items.fact: Ministerial Resolution 647 of 2020 governs inclusive education policy.

items.question: In what year did the UAE Ministry of Education establish the People of Determination Department, formerly the Special Education Department?
items.fact: Ministry established People of Determination Department in 2008.
